ruleDefinitions.name: System Scripts Autorun Keys Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\System\\\\Scripts.*") AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Startup.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Shutdown.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Logon.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Logoff.*")) AND  NOT (Details = "\(Empty\)")
